purpose: Machine-readable proof gates for any future benchmark-specific IGRM advantage claim.

claim_policy.rule: A narrow claim may be considered only after every registered gate for its benchmark and dimension is complete on frozen evidence, independently reviewed, and publicly reported with negative results.
required_comparison_properties: same construct or an explicit construct distinction
same geography and time interval where comparison requires them
preregistered primary outcome and decision rule
independent evaluator and blinded task materials where applicable
power or precision target and minimally important effect
multiplicity, exclusion, missing-data and stopping rules
negative and null results retained in a permanent loss register

benchmarks.name: Caldara-Iacoviello Geopolitical Risk Index
benchmarks.strength: Academic legitimacy, long history, country series, vintages and a citable paper.
benchmarks.igrm_target: Deeper India decomposition and traceability from evidence through events to exposure.
gates: Complete externally coded construct study for the production-linked IGRM frame.
Publish equal-period, version-pinned comparison with uncertainty and construct differences.
Obtain independent methods review and immutable, citable data vintages.

benchmarks.name: ACLED Conflict Index
benchmarks.strength: Event coding, actor and geographic detail, and frequent updates.
benchmarks.igrm_target: Connect coded events to India-specific exposure and downstream evidence.
gates: Run blinded event inclusion, timing, actor and location error study.
Publish geographic, event-class and source-coverage audit.
Benchmark update latency on the same eligible event frame.

benchmarks.name: International Country Risk Guide
benchmarks.strength: Decision-oriented political, economic and financial country-risk structure.
benchmarks.igrm_target: Transparent and traceable India business-exposure scenarios.
gates: Freeze realistic analyst tasks and evaluation rubric before recruitment.
Run randomized crossover study measuring accuracy, time and calibration.
Publish evidence-error and abstention outcomes, not satisfaction alone.

benchmarks.name: Economic Policy Uncertainty Index
benchmarks.strength: Disciplined text-index construction, human audit and academic adoption.
benchmarks.igrm_target: India-specific multi-source decomposition with exact evidence lineage.
gates: Field independent precision and recall study matched to production contribution units.
Publish dictionary, source and normalization sensitivity across frozen vintages.
Demonstrate out-of-sample stability without retrospective term changes.

benchmarks.name: World Uncertainty Index
benchmarks.strength: A common source enabling a long and internationally comparable panel.
benchmarks.igrm_target: Preserve explicit comparability while adding much deeper India detail.
gates: Register a common country schema and comparable coverage denominator.
Test measurement invariance and language/source sensitivity.
Publish missing-country, missing-period and non-comparability flags.

benchmarks.name: Global Peace Index
benchmarks.strength: Public reach, indicator architecture and published weighting robustness.
benchmarks.igrm_target: Higher-frequency evidence with transparent sensitivity and India drill-down.
gates: Publish full weighting, normalization and missing-layer sensitivity.
Run public comprehension study on units, limits and uncertainty.
Benchmark revision latency and evidence traceability on matched observations.

benchmarks.name: Fragile States Index
benchmarks.strength: Mixed quantitative, content-analysis and expert-review workflow.
benchmarks.igrm_target: Source-level provenance and signed expert disagreement rather than opaque consensus.
gates: Register expert selection, conflicts, compensation and adjudication rules.
Audit coder agreement, revisions and dissent preservation.
Independently reproduce all rights-permitted quantitative transformations.

benchmarks.name: INFORM Risk Index
benchmarks.strength: Separation of hazard/exposure, vulnerability and coping capacity.
benchmarks.igrm_target: A live India exposure and capacity graph at route, sector and state level.
gates: Audit graph edge precision, coverage, effective dates and quantitative denominators.
Publish sensitivity to missing edges and alternative exposure mappings.
Pass registered researcher, business and policy decision tasks.

benchmarks.name: Global Supply Chain Pressure Index
benchmarks.strength: Connection of shipping, airfreight and survey data to physical supply-chain pressure.
benchmarks.igrm_target: Geopolitical attribution and India corridor, commodity and sector specificity.
gates: Freeze transmission outcomes, horizons and naive/GSCPI baselines.
Run strictly out-of-sample comparison with no-lookahead enforcement.
Publish calibration, uncertainty and negative results by corridor and sector.

benchmarks.name: Baltic Dry Index
benchmarks.strength: A narrow, trusted and widely used real-economy freight signal.
benchmarks.igrm_target: Explain India-relevant route and commodity transmission without diluting the physical measure.
gates: Secure documented rights and reproducible vintage handling for physical inputs.
Audit India route, vessel-class and commodity coverage.
Benchmark timeliness and decision utility without recasting freight as geopolitical truth.

benchmarks.name: Worldwide Governance Indicators
benchmarks.strength: Multi-source aggregation, uncertainty reporting and reproducibility materials.
benchmarks.igrm_target: Fact-level provenance and explicit uncertainty across every output family.
gates: Publish uncertainty semantics and calibration study for every summary output.
Complete independent authenticated release reproduction.
Audit source dependence, aggregation and missingness treatment.

benchmarks.name: BlackRock Geopolitical Risk Dashboard
benchmarks.strength: Decision-focused investor experience and scenario communication.
benchmarks.igrm_target: A public, evidence-linked and India-specific research and decision workflow.
gates: Run blinded task benchmark for correctness, time, calibration and citation errors.
Pass accessibility, mobile, low-bandwidth and comprehension evaluations.
Publish latency, abstention, reliability and correction performance.
